text: Select: canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, type, relation, value, units. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, activities, assays, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno AND compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id AND activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613797'. Sort: none. Limit: none.
